name: samguk-v92-totalwar-officer-detail-ui
changes: Officer detail modal rebuilt with a large left portrait and Total War inspired dark oriental layout
Officer stats schema expanded with authority while preserving the existing four-stat gameplay systems
Officer schema now supports title, salary, age, traits and portraitUrl
Detail modal now shows five gauges: leadership, war, intelligence, charisma and authority
Old calculation-heavy lower layout replaced by trait/effect cards
Existing skill effects, captive temperament modifiers and governor effects are reused as trait descriptions
Assignment controls and scheme commands remain available in a compact command section
New officer metadata and stats are included in strategy serialization v3 with backward hydration for v1/v2
